description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'ReturnReason' within the Opencart admin module. The class handles tasks related to return reasons, including generating task lists, creating localized JSON files of return reasons, and clearing these files. It includes methods for listing, generating, and deleting return reason data, working with stores and languages configured in the system.

classes.name: ReturnReason
classes.description: A controller class managing return reason tasks within the Opencart admin system, facilitating task scheduling, JSON generation, and cleanup for return reasons across stores and languages.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of tasks for return reasons across stores and languages.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Creates a localized JSON file of return reasons for a specified store and language.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes existing JSON files of return reasons for all stores and languages.
